2608.16503.title: NebulaVLA: A Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model With Guide Action for Robotic Manipulation
2608.16503.paper_summary: Real-world deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is often bottlenecked by efficiency-performance trade-offs, cross-embodiment generalization, and execution smoothness. We present NebulaVLA, an asynchronous dual-frequency architecture that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level action control, optimizing computational resources and modularity. To bridge semantic gaps across heterogeneous robots, we introduce GESTURE-7, a unified language-grounded action representation. Furthermore, our Guide Action algorithm enforces kinematic continuity via mask-based smoothness constraints. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that NebulaVLA significantly outperforms synchronous baselines, achieving an 85.5\% average success rate on LIBERO-Plus and accelerating action generation by \textasciitilde 2.7$\times$. This asynchronous design enables highly efficient and responsive control for practical robotics.
2608.16503.paper_summary_zh: 現實世界中，視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型的部署常常受到效率與性能之間的權衡、跨實體泛化以及執行平滑度的瓶頸。我們提出了NebulaVLA，一種異步雙頻架構，將高層語義推理與低層行動控制解耦，優化計算資源和模組化。為了彌合異質機器人之間的語義差距，我們引入了GESTURE-7，一種統一的語言基礎行動表示。此外，我們的引導行動算法通過基於掩碼的平滑性約束強化運動連續性。全面的評估顯示，NebulaVLA顯著超越同步基準，在LIBERO-Plus上達到85.5\%的平均成功率，並加速行動生成約2.7$\times$。這種異步設計使得實用機器人技術能夠實現高效且靈敏的控制。
